message.content:
The crash is a heap-use-after-free in `msFreeMap` called from `msLoadMap`. Let me look at the `msLoadMap` function and understand the map file parsing. The crash state shows `msFreeMap` -> `msLoadMap` -> `mapfuzzer.c`. This means `msLoadMap` itself calls `msFreeMap` internally (probably on an error path), and then the fuzzer calls `msFreeMap` again on the returned (freed) pointer - a double-free/use-after-free.
